condition: On some weighted digraphs that do have a spanning arborescence, minimum/maximum_spanning_arborescence wrongly raise "No ... spanning arborescence in G". This happens because the weight shift applied in minimal_branching is too small.
workaround: Catch the exception and retry with transformed weights, e.g. add a large constant (2*sum(abs(w))+1) to every edge weight before calling minimum_branching/maximum_branching and check the result is spanning. Alternatively use the Edmonds class with the arborescence kind.
